As they pushed past their borders and into the great unknown, planetary pioneers found new worlds with untapped resources and unique native species. They dubbed this fresh collection of worlds the Rim—and as the spread continued ever outward, this first batch of planets that got settled eventually came to be known as the Inner Rim (so as not to be confused with the Mid Rim or Outer Rim, both of which we'll get to later.|[[Strono Tuggs]], ''[[The Ultimate Cookbook]]''|''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Cookbook]]''}} The '''Inner Rim Territories''', also known as the '''Inner Rim''' and originally known simply as the '''Rim''', was a region of [[the galaxy]] located between the [[Colonies]] and the [[Expansion Region]]. The [[planet]] [[Onderon]] was located in the Inner Rim, as well as the planets [[Riosa]], [[Birren]], [[Bastatha]], [[Arreyel]], [[Li-Toran]], [[Denon]], [[Pasher]], [[Gorse]] and its [[moon]], [[Cynda]], as well as [[Jakku]]. Members of the [[Galactic Senate]] who represented Inner Rim interests united as the [[Inner Rim Coalition]]. ==Description== {{Quote|Inner Rim worlds are interestin' in that their cultures don't feel quite as homogenized as those you find on most Core Worlds. Sure, plenty of eager outsiders showed up to claim their stakes and make their marks, but most Inner Rim planets still managed to retain a touch of their original personality—no matter how hard the Empire and First Order may have tried to stomp that out of 'em in more recent years.|[[Strono Tuggs]], ''[[The Ultimate Cookbook]]''|}} The Inner Rim was a region of [[the galaxy]] that was considered part of the "inner [[planet]]s." It consisted of a ring between the [[Colonies]] and [[Expansion Region]].''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' ==History== ===Early history=== [[File:Jakku_view.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The barren desert world of Jakku]] The Inner Rim Territories was the frontier of [[Galaxy|galactic]] civilization for [[Standard century|centuries]]. When originally settled by colonizers spreading out from the worlds of the [[Core Worlds]] and [[Colonies]],''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' this area was known simply as "the Rim," but competition for resources saw the need to expand, and the known galaxy grew into areas such as the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] and the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. The Inner Rim remained prosperous, however, as colonization spread outwards.''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' At some unknown [[time]], the Inner Rim [[planet]] of [[Birren]] was settled by both [[Alderaanian]] and [[Arkanis]]ian explorers. The planet developed a hereditary [[Monarchy|monarch]] known as the [[Supreme governor]], which had become purely ceremonial by the time of the [[New Republic]]. At some point, a number of Inner Rim-focused members of the [[Galactic Senate]] established the [[Inner Rim Coalition]] to advocate for the Inner Rim's interests.{{SWU|set=Secrets of Power|cardname=Inner Rim Coalition|type=Unit|link=7585037197|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20251009182219/https://swudb.com/card/SEC/154/inner-rim-coalition}} About a thousand [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin]], the Inner Rim world of [[Jakku]] was known to be the site of an object of value to [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]], the [[Sith Lord]] known as [[Darth]] Sidious. In [[25 BBY]],[[Gallius Rax]]'s prelude and epilogue chapters in ''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]'' are set three decades before the [[Battle of Jakku]], which takes place in [[5 ABY]]. Palpatine and his [[Advisor|Adviser]] [[Yupe Tashu]] visited Jakku to supervise an archaeological dig in [[Plaintive Hand plateau]], where the object was rumored to be [[Burial|buried]]. During that trip, Palpatine first encountered [[Gallius Rax]], a local [[Slavery|slave]] whom he sensed great potential. With Palpatine's help, Rax later rose to the position of [[Fleet Admiral]] in the [[Galactic Empire]].''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]'' ===Clone Wars===
[[File:OtuaBlanksStronghold-Bounty.png|thumb|250px|Otua Blank's fortress on Quarzite]]
During the [[Clone Wars]], the Inner Rim held strategic value to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and contained several planets that were sympathetic to the Separatist cause.''[[Entertainment Weekly's Ultimate Guide to Rogue One]]'' The Separatist [[Subjugator-class heavy cruiser|''Subjugator''-class heavy cruiser]] ''[[Malevolence]]'' crashed onto the [[Dead Moon of Antar]] in the Inner Rim during the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]].{{TCW|Destroy Malevolence|Destroy ''Malevolence''}} The Inner Rim world of [[Onderon]] later joined [[Count]] [[Dooku]]'s Confederacy. The planet was represented in the [[Separatist Senate]] by [[Mina Bonteri]],{{TCW|Heroes on Both Sides}} who was later [[assassin]]ated [[Attack on Confederate people|by]] Separatist [[agent]]s under Dooku.{{TCW|Pursuit of Peace}} The Inner Rim planet [[Quarzite]] was [[Homeworld|home]] to the [[War on Quarzite|warring]] [[Belugan]] and [[Kage]] [[species]]. In [[20 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' places the [[Battle of Dathomir]] and the [[massacre on Raydonia]] to [[20 BBY]]. As the episode this event takes place within takes place between the events of the episodes the other events are attached to according to {{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-chronological-episodeorder|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Chronological Episode Order}}, this event must also take place 20 BBY. the [[bounty hunter]]s [[Asajj Ventress]] and [[Boba Fett]] accepted a [[Safe cargo objective|job]] from the Belugan dictator [[Otua Blank]] to deliver a chest. After learning that the chest contained a young Kage woman named [[Pluma Sodi]], Ventress refused to proceed with the mission. When Fett insisted on carrying on with the job, Ventress threw him into the chest and handed Fett to Blank. She then freed Pluma and returned her to her brother [[Krismo Sodi]].{{TCW|Bounty (episode)}} In 20 BBY,''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' establishes that the events of "[[Revenge (episode)|Revenge]]" and the period of the [[Onderonian Civil War]] where the [[Onderon rebels]] were helped by [[Ahsoka Tano]] occurred in [[20 BBY]]. This period first appeared in "[[Front Runners]]," meaning at least the events of that episode must be set during that year. As {{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-chronological-episodeorder|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Chronological Episode Order}} establishes that the events of "[[A War on Two Fronts]]" occur between "Revenge" and "Front Runners," "A War on Two Fronts" must also occur in 20 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]]. the [[Galactic Republic]] sent a team consisting of the [[Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Ahsoka Tano]], and [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex]] to the planet Onderon to train a [[Onderon rebels|resistance movement]] to fight against the Separatist-backed [[Monarch of Onderon|King]] [[Sanjay Rash]] during the [[Onderonian Civil War]]. As a result, the Republic established contact with Mina's son [[Lux Bonteri]] and the rebel leader [[Saw Gerrera]].{{TCW|A War on Two Fronts}} Following a prolonged military campaign, the Republic and their [[Onderonian]] allies managed to expel the [[Confederacy military|Separatist forces]] from Onderon and reinstate [[Ramsis Dendup]] as [[King]].{{TCW|Tipping Points}} ===Imperial Era=== [[File:Tarkin-profile.png|thumb|left|250px|Moff Tarkin, the architect of the Antar Atrocity]] Following the [[Mission to Mustafar|end]] of the Clone Wars and the [[Proclamation of the New Order|establishment]] of the Galactic Empire, the Inner Rim came to hold strategic significance to the Empire as it had the Separatists before them. [[Imperial Military|Imperial forces]] under [[Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]] led a harsh crackdown on the Inner Rim [[moon]] [[Antar 4]] known as the [[Antar Atrocity]][[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']] in [[18 BBY]].''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]'' states that the [[Invasion of Mon Cala]] took place one [[Standard year|year]] after the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. As the formation of the Galactic Empire took place in [[19 BBY]] per ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'', the Invasion of Mon Cala took place around [[18 BBY]]. As ''Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition'' states that the Invasion of Mon Cala and the Antar Atrocity took place at around the same [[time]], the Antar Atrocity must have taken place around 18 BBY. Thousands of [[Gotal]]s and [[Koorivar]], including Republic loyalists, were rounded up, [[Prison|imprisoned]], and [[Death|executed]]. Although the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]] tried to cover up the events, media coverage attracted outrage in the Core Worlds. [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] Palpatine was forced to reassign Tarkin to the Western Reaches. The Empire brutally annexed Bestine IV''[[Star Wars: Geektionary: The Galaxy from A - Z]]'' and—after the activity the CIS had enjoyed in the Inner Rim during the war—established an [[Imperial naval base]] on planet as a bulwark against possible rebel incursions into the Inner Rim.''[[Entertainment Weekly's Ultimate Guide to Rogue One]]'' In [[14 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']] to [[14 BBY]]. two [[Journalist|reporters]] [[Anora Fair]] and [[Hask Taff]], who covered the Antar Atrocity, later joined [[Berch Teller]]'s [[Berch Teller's rebel cell|rebel cell]] on a [[Berch Teller campaign|campaign]] against Tarkin. In [[11 BBY]],''[[Star Wars Rebels: The Visual Guide]]'' states that [[Kanan Jarrus]] and [[Hera Syndulla]] met on [[Gorse]], as depicted in the novel [[A New Dawn (novel)|''A New Dawn'']], six [[Standard year|years]] prior to the events of ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''. ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' states that ''Star Wars Rebels'' begins in the [[Standard year|year]] [[5 BBY]], thereby dating the events of ''A New Dawn'' to [[11 BBY]]. the Imperial efficiency expert and industrialist Count [[Denetrius Vidian]] embarked on a scheme to defraud the Empire by destroying the planet [[Gorse]]'s moon [[Cynda]] in order to exploit its [[thorilide]] reserves. This brought him into [[Gorse Conflict|conflict]] with the [[Twi'lek]] rebel operative [[Hera Syndulla]] and the former [[Padawan]] [[Kanan Jarrus]]. With the unlikely help of the Imperial [[Captain]] [[Rae Sloane]], Syndulla's team managed to expose Vidian's conspiracy. Following Vidian's death, his rival [[Baron]] [[Lero Danthe]] established surface [[mining]] operations on Gorse's sunward side. During the [[Imperial Era]], the Empire was known to recruit large numbers of prospective [[Imperial cadet]]s from the Inner Rim, yet even for Inner Rim planets the Empire limited what intake it accepted from former Separatist worlds. Seven [[Standard month|months]] after the Battle of [[Yavin Prime|Yavin]], Imperial forces embarked on a crackdown on the icy Inner Rim planet of [[Zeitooine]] which led to the [[Arrests on Zeitooine|arrest]] of a [[Unidentified Zeitooine family|local family]]. Imperial atrocities of Zeitooine and other worlds helped to motivate more people including the former [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|TIE fighter pilot]] [[Thane Kyrell]] to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]].''[[Lost Stars]]'' Following the events above Yavin, the Rebel Alliance [[Lieutenant]] [[Caluan Ematt]] was [[Ambush on Taanab|ambushed]] by Imperial forces on the Inner Rim world of [[Taanab]] but managed to flee to the planet [[Cyrkon]] in [[Hutt Space]].''[[Smuggler's Run: A Han Solo & Chewbacca Adventure]]'' The Empire also annexed the planet [[Riosa]] and conscripted the planet's population and resources into building both the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|first]] and [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Stars]]. Riosa's manpower and resources were plundered to fuel the Imperial war machine, causing great hardship and impoverishment to the planet. The future New Republic [[Senator]] [[Ransolm Casterfo]] grew up during Imperial rule and lost his [[parent]]s to hard labor. As a result, Casterfo developed a hatred of Darth Vader. After [[Fleet]] [[Admiral]] Rax seized control of the Imperial fleets, he ordered his armadas to assemble above the planet Jakku for a showdown with the New Republic, the successor government to the Rebel Alliance. The ensuing [[Battle of Jakku]] was a cataclysmic battle which ended the [[Galactic Civil War]] in favor of the New Republic. As a result of the fighting, Jakku's surface was littered with the wreckage of countless [[starship]]s from both sides. Jakku became home to [[scavenger]]s who sifted through the wreckage for objects to sell. A month after the Battle of Jakku, the Empire was confined by the New Republic to parts of the Inner Rim and the Core Worlds as a prelude to the [[Galactic Concordance]]. ===New Republic=== At a young age, [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] was left in the care of the [[junk boss]] [[Unkar Plutt]] by her parents, [[Dathan]] and [[Miramir]], on the [[desert]] planet Jakku as they were [[Quest for Exegol|chased]] by Sidious's [[Sith assassin]], [[Ochi|Ochi of Bestoon]]. Just as they left Rey on the planet below, Ochi caught up to them over the planet and executed both. Instead of investigating Jakku, however, an inebriated Ochi found a few [[Aki-Aki]] beads Miramir had hidden on her person as a trick: assuming the planet [[Pasaana]]''[[Shadow of the Sith]]'' in the [[Expansion Region]]''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' was Rey's hiding place, Ochi left for the planet and died in its [[Forbidden Valley]]. On Jakku, Rey worked as a [[scavenger]] and hoped her family would one day return even though, deep down, she knew they would never return.{{Film|VII}} By [[28 ABY]],''[[The Star Wars Book]]'' establishes that events of the novel ''Bloodline'' occur 28 [[Standard year|years]] after those of the film [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to the year [[0 ABY]]; therefore, ''Bloodline'' occurs in [[28 ABY]]. the Inner Rim planet Riosa had joined the New Republic. The planet's senator Casterfo were aligned with the [[Centrists]], a political faction in the [[New Republic Senate|Galactic Senate]] who favored greater centralization and a stronger [[New Republic Defense Force|military]]. Riosa remained a backwater manufacturing center which had still not fully recovered from Imperial rule. Bastatha was a barren desert world independent of the Republic that hosted an [[Amaxine warriors (New Republic Era)|Amaxine warriors']] [[Amaxine warriors' camp|camp]] led by the former Imperial [[Arliz Hadrassian]], who was an agent of the [[First Order]], a remnant of the Old Empire. Following the death of Birren's reigning Supreme governor [[Mellowyn]], the [[Populists|Populist]] Senator [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] and her son [[Ben Solo]] were designated as the heirs to the supreme governorship. Since Leia and Ben were not interested in assuming that office, Organa agreed to support [[Lady]] [[Carise Sindian]]'s bid to inherit the supreme governorship of Birren. However, Sindian was an undercover First Order agent who used her position to discover information about Organa's true parentage as the daughter of Darth Vader. The ensuing scandal destroyed Organa's [[Politics|political]] career. In retaliation, Organa convinced the [[Elder Houses]] to strip Sindian of all her royal titles. ===The Rise of The First Order=== [[File:SSD_Ravager_wreck_TFA.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Jakku's surface was littered with wrecked warships]] In [[34 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' the [[Resistance]] [[Resistance pilot|pilot]] [[Poe Dameron]] traveled to Jakku in order to find [[Lor San Tekka]], who had obtained a [[Map to Skywalker|map]] that would lead them to the [[Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker]]'s location. [[First Order military|First Order forces]] then [[Attack on Tuanul|attacked]] [[Tuanul]] [[Sacred Villages|village]] and massacred the inhabitants. Dameron was captured by Kylo Ren but managed to hide the map in his [[droid]] [[BB-8]]. Dameron later [[Escape from the Finalizer|escaped]] with the help of the disillusioned [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] [[Finn]]. After crashing their stolen [[TIE/sf space superiority fighter|TIE fighter]], the two were separated and Finn managed to find BB-8 and Rey.
